requirements_summary: Workload: interactive clinician chat (short context windows) + embeddings for semantic search. Targets: p95 latency <200ms for typical queries, throughput 30 reqs/s initially. Cost sensitivity: moderate (wants dedicated commitment discount). Must support VPC/private deployment, customer KMS, SOC2/ISO answers, audit logs and optional EU residency. Model routing: prefer open models but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified variants; need fallback policy for capacity constraints.
